name: Mikoshiba Rio
source:
The elder of Mikoshiba twins. The soft-spoken, responsible, calm but authoritative sister, she's the one moderating Rea when she goes overboard. She appears to take a liking to [url=https://vndb.org/c16734]Itsuki[/url], because of his attitude that she finds perhaps saddening. 

[From [url=http://renai.gwathyr.net/pictures/CH/]renai.gwathyr.net[/url]]
